messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Increased 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Pager triggered for SRE on-call.

emily: I'm on it — seeing a big spike starting ~14:01 UTC. Errors are 502/504 timeouts from inference runtime.

raj: grabbing metrics now. CPU on the pool looks fine, but GPU memory pressure jumps coincident with scale-in events. Link: https://metrics.company/internal/d/abc123

marina: I see a flooding of KV cache miss logs during node drains. Sample from logs: 
```
2026-03-15T14:01:12Z host=gw-12 kv_miss=1 model=redwood-v2 seq_len=512 batch_id=344 err=timeout
2026-03-15T14:01:13Z host=gw-07 kv_miss=0 model=redwood-v2 seq_len=10 batch_id=345 ok=1
2026-03-15T14:01:14Z host=gw-12 kv_miss=1 model=redwood-v2 seq_len=512 batch_id=346 err=timeout
```
These kv_miss spikes align with autoscaler evictions.

david: hypothesis 1: autoscaler scale-down is evicting nodes with hot KV cache; requests routed to cold nodes causing repeated cache loads and higher p99 latency/timeouts.

emily: hypothesis 2: a runtime kernel change from yesterday (commit abc1234) introduced a regression in KV cache warmup path when containers start. We rolled that commit to canary at 02:00 UTC.

raj: quick experiment: can we pin the pool min_size to avoid scale-in for 15m and see effect? If error drops, it's scale-related. I'll apply now to the affected pool.

marina: i've pushed a quick revert of the canary runtime to previous image on one canary node (sha def567). Early results: error rate down ~78% on that canary within 4 minutes.

emily: good signal — that points strongly at the runtime change. We should run a scoped revert to the primary fleet for next 10 minutes while we validate. Owners: marina (deploy), emily (monitor), raj (autoscale config).

jessica: customer impact: current rate-limited errors affecting enterprise accounts: AcmeCorp and Nimbus. I'll start a short customer note: "We are aware of increased errors, temporary mitigation in progress" and link to status page.

david: we need logs for post-incident RCA: please bundle the runtime logs, KV cache traces, and autoscaler events for the window 13:55-14:20 UTC. Command:
```bash
# fetch logs for the window
logcli query 'service:runtime AND model:redwood-v2' --start 2026-03-15T13:55:00Z --end 2026-03-15T14:20:00Z > /tmp/incident-1976543210-runtime.log
# autoscaler events
logcli query 'service:autoscaler' --start 2026-03-15T13:55:00Z --end 2026-03-15T14:20:00Z > /tmp/incident-1976543210-autoscaler.log
```
Attach those to the RCA doc.

emily: log bundles uploaded to incident drive: https://drive.company/incident/1976543210/logs (runtime + autoscaler + sample traces). Also sharing a curated grep for kv_miss: `grep kv_miss /tmp/incident-1976543210-runtime.log | head -n 200`

raj: mitigation applied: min_pool_size increased from 2 -> 6 for pool-us-west-2 for 20m. Monitoring p50/p95/p99.

marina: rollback to stable image scheduled for 14:10 and completed at 14:13. Canary metrics show recovery. Will keep rollback for 30m pending further validation.

david: proposed experiment plan (post-incident):
- reproduce locally with controlled scale-in (script provided)
- add unit test ensuring KV warmup path runs async before serving heavy seq_len requests
- revert-only AB test to confirm regression correlated exactly with commit abc1234
Owners: david (repro script + tests), marina (deploy AB), emily (monitor).

emily: on-call handoff note: I'll hand to marina at 15:00 UTC. Marina will be primary until the follow-ups are resolved.

jessica: customer comms sent to affected accounts, status updated on status.redwood.ai. Will follow up after rollback stabilization.

marina: next steps for RCA: capture timeline + hypothesis matrix in the incident doc, include the revert test results and log slices. I'm creating the RCA page now: https://confluence.company/incident-1976543210-rca

david: adding checklist for rollout safety: add KV cache warmup healthcheck, avoid routing traffic to a node until warmup=complete flag set. This prevents cold-node p99 spikes.

emily: summary (for thread):
- root cause hypothesis: regression in runtime kernel (commit abc1234) causing KV cache warmup failures under scale-in
- mitigation: revert to previous runtime image across fleet + temporarily increased min_pool_size
- impact: brief 502/504 spike affecting p99 latency and some enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, Nimbus)
- follow-ups: reproduce + add tests (david), rollout safety flags (raj), postmortem doc + customer note (jessica)

incident-bot: NOTE: Handoff recorded — oncall emily -> marina at 15:00 UTC. Pager cleared.
